_comment: Legacy dataset ids (DESIGN.md 4.2). Every id that existed before the per-patch datasets keeps resolving to the same build. Read it through tools/lib/patches.js (aliases()).

masteries / runes / reforged: alias id -> { to: canonical id, codec?: legacy codec key (masteries only; data/masteries/legacy-codecs.js), note? }. These three maps are LOL_ALIASES in patch-registry.js.
plain: a hash with no '<id>|' prefix (index.html#<code> = s3-pbe codes, runes.html#<30 ids> = V7.21).
keep: legacy ids that stay canonical (they name a listed patch). aliases + keep + plain.masteries = the 24 legacy ids that must resolve (check G5).

s1-final.note: Old label V1.0.0.130 was wrong (.130 is a Season 2 patch). A Demolisher point is dropped (removed in V1.0.0.63); Preservation hashRanks 3 stays.

s3-pbe.note: Was the 11/28 PBE values; now the live V1.0.0.152 values (Legendary Armor 2/3.5/5, Scout 5 s, Bladed Armor).

s4-final.note: Same build, now in Season 5 (V4.20 is Preseason 5). ~-prefixed codes still decode.

s6-launch.note: The legacy slot order in Cunning T2/T4 is handled by the codec.

preReforged-V6.24.note: Identical catalog (the V6.22-V7.2 state); now in Season 7.

rr-v12-23.note: No change V12.20 -> V12.23; now in Season 13.
